title: Toji Build
author: Jonathan Montoya
desc: This program will sculpt your body using Arnold’s splits (basically just supersets) to aesthetic build, with also giving you strength as you go. Also do these workouts for a month the go to Toji build part2

ex.note:
Horizontal arm swings
Vertical arm swings 
Arm crossovers 
Full arm swings 
Trunk rotations
Banded dislocations
Banded pull aparts
Banded external rotation (each arm)
Wall slides - go to yt

ss.note: Once you perform one set of chest perform one set of pull ups then rest 2-3 mins then repeat.(supersets)
If you can’t do weighted do body weight till max
Cross arms and push with your chest
